name: Bright Data
verdict: No OAuth, and customers do not connect accounts: you use your own API key. Some products appear to need identity verification (KYC), inferred from the docs; same day, or 1-3 days if KYC applies.
needGuide: No — create an API key in Account settings, and check whether KYC applies to the products you need.

auth.detail: API key as Authorization: Bearer <token>, or proxy-style username brd-customer-[ACCOUNT_ID]-zone-[ZONE] with a per-zone password. Keys have permission levels (Admin, Finance, Ops, Limit, User), optional expiry, and are shown only once. Agent API keys authenticate the MCP server. No OAuth documented. The MCP quickstart page shows https://mcp.brightdata.com/sse?token=<API_TOKEN>; that page may be dated.

effort.timeToProduction: 1-3 days if KYC review applies; otherwise same day

approval.gate: No OAuth gate. Some products (residential network, Web Unlocker) appear to require identity verification (KYC): the docs say access without KYC requires an SSL certificate, so expect verification for full access. This is inferred from that note. Customers do not connect accounts.

scopes.why: No OAuth scopes; permissions follow the user role and the key.
scopes.summary: No OAuth scopes; permission is per user role (Admin, Finance, Ops, Limit, User) and per key.

cost: Pay-as-you-go from about $1 per 1,000 requests for Unlocker, Crawl and SERP APIs; Residential from $2.50/GB; MCP free tier is 5,000 requests per month per account
prerequisites: Account and owner: Only account admins can generate API keys; each user can have one key and total keys cannot exceed the number of account users. Use a company-owned admin account.
Where you register: Control panel, then Account settings, then Add API key; choose user, permissions and expiration, then save
Cost: Pay-as-you-go from about $1 per 1,000 requests for Unlocker, Crawl and SERP APIs; Residential from $2.50/GB; MCP free tier is 5,000 requests per month per account

registerAt.path: Control panel, then Account settings, then Add API key; choose user, permissions and expiration, then save

steps.do: Create a company account and complete any KYC prompts
Add an API key in Account settings with limited permissions and an expiry
Store the key (shown once) in a secrets manager; refresh creates a new key and revokes the old one
Call the chosen product (Unlocker, SERP or Scraper API) with Bearer auth
Create a separate Agent API key for MCP use and test the remote server
Add per-job cost caps and a compliance review of scraping targets

roles.team: Only account admins can generate API keys; each user can have one key and total keys cannot exceed the number of account users. Use a company-owned admin account.
roles.console: Add users under account settings and assign Admin, Finance, Ops, Limit or User permissions.
roles.customer: None. Customers do not connect accounts; if they bring their own Bright Data account they paste a key you store encrypted.

testing: Use the free tier (5,000 MCP requests a month shared across team users) and several products' free tiers.

blockers.problem: Only admins can create keys and the key is shown once
Key count is capped by user count
blockers.fix: Add a user before adding another key.

blockers.problem: KYC verification may be required for residential and unlocker products
Scraping targets' ToS and data-protection law apply

automation.agentCan: Write the API clients, configure the MCP server, run test calls and add cost controls.
automation.humanMust: Create the account, pass any KYC, pay, create and store keys as admin, and approve legal use cases.

uncertain: Exact KYC rules by product, whether the remote MCP supports OAuth, and the current remote MCP URL (the page showed an older SSE form).
